staysvic: City or Coast? Short-Stay Demand in Melbourne and Regional Victoria

Source: R/staysvic-package.R
staysvic-package.Rd

Helps someone thinking about running a short-stay rental compare the Melbourne CBD with the Great Ocean Road, the Mornington Peninsula, Geelong and other Victorian towns. Bundles cleaned Inside Airbnb listings and reviews and Homes Victoria median rents, with functions that measure seasonal demand, who operates the listings, and how many booked nights a short stay needs to out-earn a normal lease. Includes a Shiny app for exploring these questions.
